text: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender (2026 Movie) brings back peak childhood nostalgia, proving it's still the GOAT cartoon—though it's a bummer they didn't bring back the original voice cast.

The Pyramid Scheme (2026 TV Series) is a missed opportunity that only redeems itself in its final episode. Could have been way better - the series failed to deliver a compelling look at how scams operate, and disappointingly failed to share the dangers/awareness of how pyramid schemes continue to attract people. Scams succeed by selling status, confidence, and belonging rather than actual products, masking exploitation as a positive lifestyle change and targeting the psychological vulnerabilities that allow blind faith in quick wealth to flourish.
